integrity: Symbolic quadratic-form and group-theoretic proof accompanied by finite standard-library verification; finite checks do not establish the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: Odd finite fields only; dimensions four and four; anisotropic two-dimensional bivector kernel. Existing decomposable-free kernel existence and maximality are prior results. No classification of all class-two groups or absolute historical priority is asserted.
title: Two-level commutator fibers from anisotropic bivector pencils over odd finite fields
